title: Downtown Deco| 2mi to Broadway| Grill & HotTub -A
description:
Experience Downtown Deco and the luxury that awaits! Professionally designed by Brittany Snellen, this new 3-story home is perfect for families and bachelorette groups alike! Located 1.8 miles from Broadway and central to Nashville hot spots. Enjoy the rooftop deck - with a hot tub & TV + outdoor kitchen with butcher block countertops, sink, microwave & grill! Spacious floorplan and bright Deco decor. Don't wait, book now. Your Nashville stay awaits!

The space
**For larger groups or for more availability - please click our profile and check out our twin property on the same lot, "Downtown Deco-B". This home has the same floor plan and bed count. Both homes can be rented together for a maximum of 24 guests, see "Downtown Deco - A+B**

KEY FEATURES:
★ Less than 2 miles to Broadway!
★ Perfect spot for Family Vacation, Bachelor/Bachelorette Groups, and Traveling Professionals alike.
★Brand New Construction
★ Rooftop Deck - Hot Tub, Outdoor Kitchen with Grill, Mini Fridge, TV, and Seating for the whole group.
★ Parking (free, street) right outside the front door.
★ Sleeping arrangements for 12: 4 bedrooms + 1 Bonus Room, including 2 King Suites, 2 Queen Bedroom, 1 Bunk Room with Full over Full and Twin over Full beds.
★ 5 Ensuite Bathrooms
★ Modern and well-equipped kitchen with Stainless Steel Appliances (36" Stovetop Range + Range Hood), Ninja K-Cup & Carafe Coffee Pot Combo, Cooking Essentials.
★ Centrally located to all the Nashville hot spots!

HOME LAYOUT:
1ST FLOOR
★Mud Room w/Coat Hooks and Storage
★ Open layout with dining area, kitchen, and living room.
★ Dining Table and Kitchen Island with seating for the whole group (12).
★ Living Room: 65" Smart TV, Couch Seating for the whole group.
★ Fully Stocked Kitchen: Stainless Steel Appliances, 32" Thor Electric Range Stove with Range Hood, Filtered Water & Ice in the Refrigerator/Freezer, Ninja K-Cup & Carafe Coffee Pot, and Cooking Essentials.

★ BONUS ROOM: 
1 Queen Bed & Full Bathroom with Vanity Sink and Walk-In, Custom-tiled Shower, 40" Smart TV, Outlets by each bedside, Reading Lamps.

2ND FLOOR
★ BEDROOM 1 - Couple's Master King Suite 
1 King Bed with End of Bed Bench, En-Suite Bathroom with Double Vanity Sink, Make-Up Table with Magnified Mirror, Walk-In Custom Tiled Shower, 58" Smart TV, Outlets by each bedside, Reading Lamps, 2 Reading Chairs and Table.
★ BEDROOM 2 - The Bunk Room
2 Bunk Beds (Full over Full and Twin over Full), En-Suite Bathroom with Extra Long Vanity Sink, Tub/Shower Combo, 40" Smart TV, Reading Chair.

3RD FLOOR
★ BEDROOM 3 -  Birds of a Feather
1 Queen Bed, En-Suite Bathroom with Extra Long Vanity Sink, Tub/Shower Combo, 43" Smart TV, Reading Lamps.
★ BEDROOM 4 - Peacock's Perch - Penthouse King Suite
 1 King Bed, Full Bathroom with Vanity Sink, Walk-In Custom Tiled Shower, 50" Smart TV.
Double Sliding Doors with Access to Rooftop and Hottub.

★ ROOFTOP DECK
 Hot Tub, Outdoor Kitchen with Grill, Mini Fridge, TV, Dining Table, Outdoor Seating, and Good Vibes!

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire home during their stay. A code for the keyless entry smart lock on the front & back door will be sent 24 hours before your arrival. Door codes are unique to your reservation, and only active during your reservation for your security.
